name: bg3_stand_feed
description: The video stand's feed (stand/README.md): what changed since a cursor, by layers - situation (where the character is, the party's health and weapons, a fight and whose turn), seen (who and what is around now, nearest first, `new` when not listed last time), heard (lines spoken), waiting (a dialogue with its answers, a roll, a window to close), about_to (what each creature weighs and begins in a fight), dice (every roll), happened (hits, deaths, items, quests, fights begun and ended), said (your own lines), scenario. Each row has a `text` to read and the ids to act on (`who`, `target`, `at`). Pass the answer's `cursor` as `since` next time. Call it before deciding; call it again after acting.

since.description: the `cursor` of the last answer; left out: the picture now and the last rows

ways.description: also the walkable ways from the character in eight directions (slower, up to 1.5 s)

name: bg3_stand_say
description: Show the character's intent in the game before acting: `say` is a short first-person line of what you are about to do (at most 60 characters; it floats over the character's head for about 3 seconds), `at` what it is about (a uuid from the feed, a name you saw, or a point [x, y, z]): it glows, the camera glides to it and back, a soft sound plays. `think` (what the character thinks) and `do` (the plain reason) go to the feed only. `style`: intent (default), danger, found, aside. Also the way to answer the owner in character: a line with no `at`.

say.description: the line over the head, first person, short

do.description: the plain reason, for a reader of the log (feed only)

at.description: what the line is about: a uuid, a name the party knows, or a point [x, y, z]

who.description: who speaks; the controlled character when left out

style.description: intent, danger, found, aside, or an object of style fields over the default

lua: return GK.Stand.Say{ say = args.say, think = args.think, ["do"] = args["do"], at = args.at, who = args.who, style = args.style }

name: bg3_stand_accent
description: Point at something without a line: `at` (a uuid, a name the party knows, or a point [x, y, z]) glows, the camera glides to it and back, a soft sound plays. `style` as bg3_stand_say's (danger adds the violet outline).

at.description: a uuid, a name the party knows, or a point [x, y, z]

style.description: intent, danger, found, aside, or an object of style fields
